hints.title: Three Sequential States
hints.text: A special subsequence is formed by positive counts of 0s, followed by 1s, followed by 2s.

hints.title: State Transition Equations
hints.text: Maintain counts for subsequences formed solely of 0s (dp0), of 0s then 1s (dp1), and complete 0-1-2 sequences (dp2).

hints.title: Modulo Arithmetic Accumulation
hints.text: When encountering x, update dpx by doubling its existing count and appending x to the previous stage dp(x-1).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Three-variable rolling dynamic programming state machine.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^N subsequences incurs exponential time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space tracks all prefix combinations modulo 1,000,000,007.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize sequential state machine transitions (dp0 -> dp1 -> dp2).
